fnol_text: My name is Mei Takahashi and I live at 104 Sycamore Terrace, Greenville, SC 29623. You can reach me on (555) 270-3789 or mei.takahashi@example.com. There was a flood warning for our area from the day before, but I left the car parked on the street by the river. On 6 August 2024 the water rose and the car was flooded up to the seats. Policy MT-2024-00047. I'd like to claim for the damage to my car. Please just tell me this is covered.

adjuster_notes.text: Called Mrs Takahashi on (555) 270-3789 to acknowledge the claim. Mei confirmed the loss date as 6 August 2024.
Vehicle inspected at the repairer. Witness Liam Ueda gave a statement by phone.
Mei sent photos and a contractor's estimate. Water line visible on walls.
